source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 75.5 — 'very extreme' on the EFFIS scale — at Alcanadre (stage 9) on 2026-08-24, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-08-23. 22 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Alcanadre (stage 9) 75, Araia (stage 3) 63, Navarrete (stage 7) 63, Araia (stage 3) 58, Alcanadre (stage 9) 56, Logroño (stage 8) 49. At 'very high' or above: stages [1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 18]. FWI anomaly at Alcanadre is +11.1 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
